mapper.sql: EXCLUDED.window_ban_at IS NOT NULL AND (state.latest_ban_at IS NULL OR EXCLUDED.window_ban_at > state.latest_ban_at) AND (state.window_seen IS NULL OR state.window_seen <= #{previousWindow}) AND (state.window_ban_at IS NULL OR state.window_seen <= #{quietCutoff} OR EXCLUDED.window_ban_at >= state.window_ban_at + #{windowMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond')
CASE WHEN state.window_seen IS NULL OR state.window_seen <= #{quietCutoff} THEN 1 ELSE LEAST(state.windows + 1, 1000000) END
CASE WHEN window_seen > #{query.quietCutoff} AND windows >= #{query.threshold} THEN CASE WHEN #{query.suppression} THEN 'blocking' ELSE 'observing' END WHEN detected THEN 'quiet' ELSE 'replayed' END
mapper.select:
SELECT app_id::text || ':' || target::text AS id, app_id::text AS app_id, peer_network, peer_port, module_name, rule_name, first_seen, last_seen, peak_windows, replays, suppressed, () AS status FROM public.ban_submission_target
ORDER BY last_seen DESC, app_id, target LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ban_submission_replay_daily AS daily (day, app_id, replay_batches, replays) VALUES (#{day}, #{appId}, 1, #{replays}) ON CONFLICT (day, app_id) DO UPDATE SET replay_batches = daily.replay_batches + 1, replays = daily.replays + EXCLUDED.replays
mapper.select: SELECT app_id::text AS app_id, SUM(replay_batches)::bigint AS replay_batches, SUM(replays)::bigint AS replays FROM public.ban_submission_replay_daily WHERE day >= #{since} GROUP BY ban_submission_replay_daily.app_id ORDER BY replay_batches DESC, replays DESC, ban_submission_replay_daily.app_id LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: WITH events AS ( SELECT app_id, target FROM public.ban_submission_target WHERE detected OR replays > 0 ORDER BY app_id, target FOR UPDATE ) DELETE FROM public.ban_submission_target AS state USING events WHERE state.app_id = events.app_id AND state.target = events.target
